INSERT INTO [EDS].[DIGITAL_ENROLLMENTS_FACT] 
(
	 BANK_ID
	,SOURCE_CODE
	,CIF_ID
	,RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE
	,USER_NAME
	,STATUS
	,STD_STATUS
	,STATUS_DATE
	,ENROLLMENT_DATE
	,SCD_START_DATE
	,SCD_END_DATE
	,INSERT_DTTM
)
SELECT MBK_RTBKCUSTOMERMTB.BNK_CODE AS BANK_ID
	, MBK_RTBKCUSTOMERMTB.SOURCE_CODE
	, MBK_RTBKCUSTOMERMTB.CIF_NO AS CIF_ID
	, CUSTOMER_DIM.RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE AS RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE
	, MBK_RTBKCUSTOMERMTB.USER_ID AS USER_NAME
	, CASE WHEN MBK_RTBKCUSTOMERMTB.SCD_END_DATE = '9999-12-31' THEN '0' ELSE CAST(MBK_RTBKCUSTOMERMTB.STATUS AS CHAR(1)) END AS STATUS
	, CASE WHEN MBK_RTBKCUSTOMERMTB.SCD_END_DATE = '9999-12-31' THEN 'Inactive' ELSE ENROLLMENT_STATUS_DIM.STD_STATUS END AS STD_STATUS
	, CASE WHEN MBK_RTBKCUSTOMERMTB.SCD_END_DATE = '9999-12-31' THEN '2026-06-29' ELSE MBK_RTBKCUSTOMERMTB.STATUS_CHANGE_DT END AS STATUS_DATE
	, MBK_RTBKCUSTOMERMTB.CREATED_DATE AS ENROLLMENT_DATE
	, MBK_RTBKCUSTOMERMTB.SCD_START_DATE
	, MBK_RTBKCUSTOMERMTB.SCD_END_DATE
	, MBK_RTBKCUSTOMERMTB.INSERT_DTTM
FROM EDS.MBK_RTBKCUSTOMERMTB
JOIN EDS.ENROLLMENT_STATUS_DIM
ON ENROLLMENT_STATUS_DIM.STATUS_ID = CAST(MBK_RTBKCUSTOMERMTB.STATUS AS CHAR(1))
LEFT JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM ON MBK_RTBKCUSTOMERMTB.CIF_NO = CUSTOMER_DIM.ORGKEY 
AND CUSTOMER_DIM.ISACTIVE = 1 AND CUSTOMER_DIM.ISLATEST = 1 AND CUSTOMER_DIM.BNK_CODE = 'CBC01'
WHERE MBK_RTBKCUSTOMERMTB.BNK_CODE = 'CBC01'
UNION ALL
SELECT RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION.BANK_ID
	, RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION.SOURCE_CODE
	, RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION.CUST_ID
	, CUSTOMER_DIM.RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE AS RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE
	, RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION.CORP_USER
	, RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION.DEL_FLG
	, ENROLLMENT_STATUS_DIM.STD_STATUS
	, CASE WHEN RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION.DEL_FLG = 'Y' THEN CAST(RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION.R_MOD_TIME AS DATE) ELSE CAST(RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION.R_CRE_TIME AS DATE) END STATUS_DATE
	, CAST(RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION.R_CRE_TIME AS DATE) R_CRE_TIME
	, RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION.SCD_START_DATE
	, RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION.SCD_END_DATE
	, RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION.INSERT_DTTM
FROM EDS.RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION
JOIN EDS.ENROLLMENT_STATUS_DIM
ON ENROLLMENT_STATUS_DIM.STATUS_ID = RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION.DEL_FLG
LEFT JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM ON RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION.CUST_ID = CUSTOMER_DIM.ORGKEY 
AND CUSTOMER_DIM.ISACTIVE = 1 AND CUSTOMER_DIM.ISLATEST = 1 AND CUSTOMER_DIM.BNK_CODE = 'CBC01'
WHERE RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION.BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'CBC01' AS BANK_ID
	, 'D30' AS SOURCE_CODE
	, D30_CUSTOMER.CIF_ID
	, CUSTOMER_DIM.RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE AS RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE
	, D30_CUSTOMER.USERNAME
	, D30_CUSTOMER.STATUS
	, ENROLLMENT_STATUS_DIM.STD_STATUS
	, D30_CUSTOMER.ENROLLMENT_DATE
	, D30_CUSTOMER.ENROLLMENT_DATE	
	, NULL SCD_START_DATE
	, NULL SCD_END_DATE
	, NULL INSERT_DTTM
FROM EDS.D30_CUSTOMER
JOIN EDS.ENROLLMENT_STATUS_DIM
ON ENROLLMENT_STATUS_DIM.STATUS_ID = D30_CUSTOMER.STATUS
LEFT JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM ON D30_CUSTOMER.CIF_ID = CUSTOMER_DIM.ORGKEY
AND CUSTOMER_DIM.ISACTIVE = 1 AND CUSTOMER_DIM.ISLATEST = 1 AND CUSTOMER_DIM.BNK_CODE = 'CBC01';
